name: watchfloor
description: A real-time common operating picture (COP): live air and sea tracks on a tactical map.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @watchfloor/server" "npm run dev -w @watchfloor/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @watchfloor/client && npm run build -w @watchfloor/server
